svg.title: Continue heating the high-MSC reaction mixture
svg.desc: Continue heating the high-MSC reaction mixture. Continue the source 1.0 mM F360 mixture with 35 mM each In(My)3, Zn(St)2, and (TMS)3P to the three-day observation at 300 °C in Figure S15e. The three-day trace applies only to this concentration. No absolute stock charges or exact physical-batch join to a separate 90 min specimen are inferred. Conceptual process flow; vessel geometry, phase separation and particle shape are unassigned.
